status: post hoc descriptive count comparison on three frozen local worlds

method.conditioning: For each pair G retain y in G; condition separately on each start x.
method.alternative: Separate within-pair outcome probability for each (x, actuator).
method.null: One within-pair outcome probability for each x, pooled over actuator.
method.score: Sum over x of log m(counts_x0) + log m(counts_x1) - log m(counts_x0 + counts_x1).
method.evidence: Ordered observation likelihood; no binomial coefficients.
method.scope: Conditional pair dependence only; no tree recovery, speed comparison or hypothesis-test decision.
method.cross_pair_scope: Each pair conditions on different retained observations; scores are not a posterior over mutually exclusive pairs.
